rule.arms: eval/reports/<stem>_offset_fit.json segment_lengths_m: median landmark-to-landmark distance over the recording (eval/offset/carry.py seg_lengths), reused at 3 dp
rule.torso: E-031/E-035: median over frames with fail_torso == 0 of the distance from the recovery pelvis (angles_recovery.csv pel_x/y/z, y negated into the landmark camera frame) to the measured mid-shoulder of the filtered landmarks

capture_note: E-031 to E-033 captures used the receiver default torsoM 0.576 m (this rule evaluated 2026-09-07; E-035 records 0.5745 for it) and the receiver's loop arm constants, not this recording's arm lengths.
